headline: From 2027, Kyrgyz citizens in Russia will have to confirm income for the whole family
summary: From 1 January 2027, new income requirements for foreign workers in Russia take effect, including for Kyrgyz citizens. Migrant workers must confirm income for their families, according to the report.
why: Migrant labour flows from Central Asia support remittance income and labour supply in Russia, so changes to work-permit rules affect both host and sending economies.
original_headline: С 2027 года кыргызстанцам в России придется подтверждать доходы на всю семью
